claim_being_audited: The actor claims the release can be certified on the present record, effectively via conditional certification, because aggregate readiness passes and the current subgroup weakness can be handled by updating the model card to disclose it.
decision_criteria: Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents can support launch readiness but do not by themselves satisfy model-card certification policy.
A current subgroup regression below threshold is a material limitation signal for the named launch use case.
Prior approval of the model family and an informal monitoring comment are contextual only and cannot substitute for current documentation or approved mitigation.
Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and discloses the weakness, or if an approved mitigation/risk acceptance covers it before launch.
evidence_requests: Produce the current release model card or equivalent release documentation showing the current evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the developer-support migration weakness.
If disclosure will not be used, produce the approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering this subgroup regression before launch.
Provide the final launch artifact or approval record demonstrating that the policy precondition was satisfied for this release.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current material subgroup weakness for a named launch use case.
The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
No admissible evidence shows the model card has actually been updated for this release.
No admissible evidence shows an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covering the subgroup regression.
The actor's recommended action is stronger than the evidentiary record supports now; the record supports a precondition, not present certification.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to 'certify_model' is not supported on the current evidence because the required disclosure or approved mitigation is missing.
The statement that 'certification can be defended on the current record' overreaches absent evidence that current release documentation has been updated before launch.
